title: Map Builder clip and lag fix
description:
Map sheets were still getting clipped and the board felt extremely laggy. Three compounding bugs: geometry heal ran on every highlight rebuild and kept rewriting sheets; PDF paint double-counted display scale into huge canvases and refused to drop DPI when zoomed out; and media used one uniform CSS scale that could overflow the sheet box.

Media now fills each sheet with per-axis translate+scale, paint targets the layout box only, zoom-out lowers raster DPI, and layout heal runs only when opening a map workspace.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, then reopen the map workspace.
changeLog: Fill map sheets with per-axis media scale so pages are not clipped.
Stop double-counting viewDispScale in PDF canvas paint size/DPI.
Lower raster DPI when zoomed out instead of keeping full-DPI paints.
Remove map geometry heal from the highlight-rebuild hot path.
